title: rbjson sets
description: sets/sets.json: every set a printing can belong to, as Riot's card gallery lists them.

id.description: Riot's set code, the prefix of every card number in the set (OGN-004/298). A promo set takes its TCGplayer abbreviation (OPP, PR, JDG).

type.description: The set's product line. AutoMana maps it onto MTG's set types: booster=expansion, starter=starter, promo=promo.

collectorNumberMax.description: The set size printed after the slash on every card (the 298 of OGN-004/298). A card numbered above it is an overnumbered variant. A promo set has none: its cards carry the sizes of the sets they reprint.

parent.description: The set this one ships with, as MTG's parent_set: a starter set names the booster set it came out beside.

logo.description: The set's logo, hotlinked from the page that shows it (source). Absent: Riot publishes no standalone set logos.

keyArt.description: The hero image of the set's announcement on playriftbound.com (source), hotlinked from Riot's CDN: its pixel size, and optionally the crop [x, y, width, height] that keeps only the artwork when the image holds more. Absent when the set has no announcement of its own.

tcgplayerGroupIds.description: The TCGplayer groups that sell the set, from TCGCSV category 89; a group's abbreviation is the set code.

cardmarketExpansionIds.description: The Cardmarket expansions that sell the set's cards, from Cardmarket's Riftbound product list (game 22). Kept by hand.
